<description>
Part of #36692. This keeps `CMutableTransaction` as the builder, since a `CTransaction` constructor taking inputs and outputs directly is still under discussion. Once one exists, these call sites can be converted to construct `CTransaction` directly.

This PR covers the mempool-related files.

This change is test- and bench-only and does not change the constructed transactions.

Notes for reviewers: two spots in `rbf_tests` that modify an existing transaction as part of the test logic are intentionally left unchanged.
</description>

<commits>
b7abd88f0f test: construct mempool_tests inputs/outputs declaratively

Replace the field-by-field construction of inputs and outputs in
mempool_tests with COutPoint, CTxIn and CTxOut constructor calls.

The txChild loop variable in MempoolRemoveTest is changed to uint32_t to
avoid a narrowing conversion in COutPoint{}. The constructed
transactions are unchanged.

e56fbbfe5d bench: construct mempool_eviction inputs/outputs declaratively

Replace the field-by-field construction of inputs and outputs in
MempoolEviction with COutPoint, CTxIn and CTxOut constructor calls.

Since CTxIn has no witness constructor argument, the witnesses are added
after vin is replaced. The constructed transactions are unchanged.

30ad3ca75d test: construct rbf_tests make_tx inputs/outputs declaratively

Replace resizing the vectors and assigning fields by index in make_tx
with appending constructed CTxIn and CTxOut elements. The witness is
added directly to the new input instead of through a temporary
CScriptWitness. The constructed transactions are unchanged.
</commits>
